howItWorks.title: How to convert Markdown to PDF
steps: Upload the Markdown file you want to convert.
Click Start to render it as a PDF.

items.a: Headings, paragraphs, bold/italic text, links, lists, tables, code blocks, and blockquotes all render with clean, readable formatting — similar to how GitHub renders a README.

items.q: Can I use raw HTML inside my Markdown file?
items.a: No — raw HTML tags are treated as plain text rather than rendered, for security reasons. Stick to standard Markdown syntax.

items.q: Is converting Markdown to PDF free?
items.a: Yes, within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
